The '''Paradise Towers' Residents Social Association''' was an organization that operated in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Hedrett]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Beem Dwaller]] was the [[President/Legends|president]] of it and in about [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Caleb Clancy]] attended an Association picnic, where he operated the barbecue.
